title: Nobel Laureate Doris Lessing on Breaking Free from the Prisons We Choose to Live Inside
author: Maria Popova
summary: This is the history of the world: revolutionaries turning into tyrants, leaders who claim to stand with the masses turning the individuals within them on each other, stirring certainties and self-righteousness to distract from the uncomfortable unknowns, from the great open question of what makes us and keeps us human, and human together.
